value: Land Code (Jordabalken, SFS 1970:994), chapter 12 on leases (hyra).

field: Notice for an open-ended dwelling lease
value: An open-ended lease of a dwelling may, unless a longer period is agreed, be terminated to end at the month-end occurring after three months from the notice (12 kap. 4 §).

If landlord and tenant dispute the rent, it is set at a reasonable amount; rent is not reasonable if it is markedly higher than the rent for flats of equivalent utility value, with rents agreed in collective negotiations under the Rent Negotiation Act mainly taken into account (12 kap. 55 §).

For a dwelling the tenancy is forfeited and the landlord may terminate early if the tenant is more than one week late paying rent after the due date, subject to the exceptions in 12 kap. 55 e § (12 kap. 42 §).
